h1: Top Inn Hotel — a central Maha Sarakham hotel with newly renovated rooms and easy parking on a budget
intro: Want a central Maha Sarakham hotel that is easy to reach, easy to park at, and easy on the wallet? Top Inn Hotel in the Talat market area on Rim Khlong Somthawin Road is a midrange 3-star hotel that renovated its rooms in 2024 · What reviewers mention most is clean rooms, friendly staff and spacious parking, with the hospital, bus station and downtown restaurants all close by · Prices start from approx. ฿620/night and it holds a score of 8.2 from 20 reviews on Trip.com — solid for this price bracket.

body.html: Top Inn Hotel sits at 45/6 Rim Khlong Somthawin Road, Talat sub-district, Mueang Maha Sarakham, open since 2018 and with rooms renovated in 2024 — its strength is the central, downtown Talat location, easy to get in and out of and close to the hospital, bus station, restaurants and the city's main points of interest · It is a 50-room hotel with free, spacious parking, which makes it handy for anyone driving their own car: business travellers, relatives staying near a patient at the hospital, and parents dropping students off in town.

Rooms come in several types — Standard Twin, Standard King and Family Room — and after the 2024 renovation many guests describe them as fresh-looking, clean and roomier than expected · Every room has air conditioning, a satellite flat-screen TV, a kettle, toiletries and a private bathroom · There is free Wi-Fi in the common areas, an on-site restaurant, a meeting room, laundry service, and a 24-hour front desk with room service · A simple breakfast is available as an add-on, so it is worth checking the details with the hotel before you book.
"Newly renovated, clean rooms, friendly and helpful staff, big secure car park, central location close to the hospital and plenty of food nearby — good value."

What earns Top Inn Hotel its 8.2 is cleanliness and location · Most reviews praise the helpful staff, clean rooms, easy parking and proximity to everything in town — hospital, bus station and restaurants alike · Many call it a sensible choice for an overnight stay while running errands in the city: not luxurious, but everything you need at a price you can justify · A few reviewers also mention a simple breakfast that does the job.

To be honest — this is a value-focused midrange hotel, not a full-service luxury property · Some reviews note the walls are fairly thin, so you can occasionally hear the room next door · A few beds are starting to show their age, water pressure is weak in places, and the bathrooms are on the small side without separate wet and dry zones · One reviewer mentioned small bugs in the bathroom and the cleanliness of the surrounding streets, which is worth knowing — even though most reviews praise the cleanliness of the rooms themselves.

In short, Top Inn Hotel suits anyone who wants a central Maha Sarakham hotel with newly renovated, clean rooms, easy parking and low prices · Set your expectations right — a midrange hotel built around location and value rather than luxury — and it does the job well · Its score of 8.2 from 20 reviews reflects that most guests leave satisfied, especially those who need a place close to the hospital and the city centre.

honestSummary: Top Inn Hotel is a midrange hotel with newly renovated, clean rooms, a central location and low prices, ideal for anyone who wants a convenient base near the hospital and bus station with ample parking in Maha Sarakham · The trade-off is fairly thin walls, small bathrooms and a few fittings showing their age.
honestChecks: If you are a light sleeper sensitive to noise — reviews note the walls are fairly thin and you can sometimes hear the next room → ask for an upper-floor or corner room and pack earplugs.
If you want a pool or full hotel services — this is a midrange hotel focused on clean rooms and location → consider a 4-star property in the province such as Taksila or DEBUA White House.
If a large bathroom with separate wet and dry zones matters to you — the bathrooms here are on the small side → check recent room photos and reviews before booking, or pick a larger room type.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Top Inn Hotel, Maha Sarakham

faq.q: Where is Top Inn Hotel in Maha Sarakham?
faq.a: It sits at 45/6 Rim Khlong Somthawin Road, Talat, Mueang Maha Sarakham · This is a central, downtown market location that is easy to reach, close to the hospital, bus station and city restaurants.

faq.q: What kind of property is Top Inn Hotel?
faq.a: It is a midrange 3-star hotel, open since 2018 and with rooms renovated in 2024, with 50 rooms in total · It offers Standard Twin, Standard King and Family rooms with air conditioning, satellite flat-screen TV, a kettle and a private bathroom.

faq.q: What are the starting prices and room types?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿620/night for a Standard Twin · There are also Standard King and Family rooms · Prices vary by season, so compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Does Top Inn Hotel have parking and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes — it has free, spacious and secure parking, ideal for self-drivers · A simple breakfast is available as an add-on, so check the details and packages with the hotel before booking · There is no pool, as this is a midrange hotel focused on clean rooms and location.

faq.q: Is Top Inn Hotel noisy — is it comfortable to sleep in?
faq.a: Most rooms were renovated in 2024 and are clean and comfortable, but some reviews note the walls are fairly thin and you can occasionally hear the next room · If you are a light sleeper, ask for a corner or upper-floor room and pack earplugs.

faq.q: Who is Top Inn Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits anyone who wants a central hotel with newly renovated, clean rooms, easy parking and low prices · It is great for people running errands in town, relatives visiting a patient at the hospital, or self-drivers, and less ideal for those wanting full luxury-hotel facilities.
